nodes.label: Placeholder SVG Image
nodes.description: A 1200x1200 SVG placeholder image with a light gray (#EAEAEA) background, a centered circle with crosshair lines (horizontal, vertical, and diagonal), and a small camera/image icon in the center. Used as a generic image placeholder in the React frontend prototype.

nodes.label: Image Placeholder UI Pattern
nodes.description: A common UI pattern for representing missing or unloaded images. The crosshair-circle-icon motif visually communicates 'image goes here' to developers and designers during prototyping.
